owner_and_source: Google/MobilityData GTFS-Realtime specification (github.com/google/transit), gtfs-realtime/spec/en/examples/trip-updates-full.asciipb -- the canonical reference TripUpdate example for the most widely deployed real-time transit standard
license_and_commercial_rights: Apache-2.0 (repository LICENSE); commercial use permitted with attribution and license notice retained
schema_and_format: GTFS-Realtime FeedMessage in protobuf text format (.asciipb): TripUpdate entities with per-stop arrival/departure predictions and schedule deviations. Parsed via google.protobuf.text_format into the official gtfs-realtime-bindings FeedMessage. GTFS-Realtime is the operational real-time counterpart to static GTFS -- vehicle positions, trip updates, and service alerts.
canonical_contract: themis.canonical.entities.Outcome (GTFS-Realtime operational signals -> Outcome, the closest canonical operational record; see themis/connect/gtfs_realtime.py and the operational-entity gap flagged for ADR 0030+)

quality_tests.name: parses_as_feedmessage
quality_tests.description: retained object parses as a GTFS-Realtime FeedMessage with at least one entity

acceptance_threshold: downloads, non-empty, parses as a GTFS-Realtime FeedMessage containing TripUpdate entities
retention_and_deletion: retain as part of the standards-adapter certification corpus; cheaply reproducible (re-fetchable from upstream) so evictable first
